claims.text: This excerpt shows a series of events related to HDFS block management, including the addition of nodes to the block map and the termination of PacketResponders for specific blocks.
The addition of nodes to the block map, as seen in multiple "NameSystem.addStoredBlock" messages, indicates that new blocks are being stored on different nodes in the system.
The termination of PacketResponders and the receipt of a block from a specific node also suggest ongoing data transfer and management activities within the system.
